Gravimetric moisture
(Wm − Wd)/Wd × 100, oven-drying at 105°C; the standard method.
Moisture depth
cm per m = bulk density × moisture %; bulk density 1.1–1.6 g/cm³.
Tensiometer
Porous cup + gauge; reads tension; fails above 0.85 atm; for sandy soils.
Neutron moisture meter
Fast neutrons slowed by hydrogen; in-situ, rapid, whole root zone.
Waterlogging norms (GoI 1991)
Waterlogged <2 m; potential 2–3 m; safe >3 m water-table depth.
Saline / alkali / saline-alkali
Saline: EC>4, ESP<15, pH<8.5. Alkali: EC<4, ESP>15, pH>8.5. Saline-alkali: EC>4, ESP>15.
Waterlogged area in India (NCA 1976)
6.0 Mha = 3.4 Mha surface stagnation + 2.6 Mha high water table.
Why drains cannot over-drain
They remove only gravitational water, never capillary water.
SAR
Sodium Adsorption Ratio — sodium relative to Ca and Mg; measures sodicity hazard.
Drainage coefficient
Depth of water removed in 24 h; 6–25 mm/day for small projects.
Observation well vs piezometer
Well: perforated over its length → water table. Piezometer: open at bottom only → pressure head at a point.
Excess water and water table
1 cm of excess percolation raises the water table 8–10 cm; canal seepage 10–30% of delivery.
Design storms
Surface drains 5–15 yr; major works 25 yr; minor crossings 10 yr; field structures 5 yr.
